channel.title: NautGate engineering notes
channel.description: Engineering notes about LLM privacy, routing, model evidence and local inference.

item.title: Tailscale first: the best way to run NautGate for your whole network
item.description: Put one NautGate server behind Tailscale Serve, keep port 8090 off the public internet, and give every approved device a private HTTPS gateway.

item.title: Prove which model actually answered
item.description: Why an LLM's self-description is not proof of identity, and how NautGate records the served model from provider response metadata.

item.title: Offline should mean no egress
item.description: Local inference is not enough when background services keep calling home. What NautGate offline mode stands down and how socket sampling verifies it.

item.title: Why I built NautGate
item.description: A year of watching routing, context, latency, drift, and model substitution changed how I think about privacy—and why I am opening NautGate to everyone now.
